title: Ins Video & Photo Saver
summary: Save videos, photos, stories and music from supported links. Fast and easy.
description:
InSaver – Video & Photo Saver for Supported Social Media Links

InSaver is an independent video and photo saver designed to help users save media from supported social media links they can access.

The app works with links copied or shared by the user. It helps detect supported media links, parse available content, and save videos, photos, stories, posts, and music to your device when available.

InSaver is useful when you want to keep your favorite videos and photos for offline viewing, personal backup, or easy access later.

Why InSaver?
Many users want a simple way to save videos and photos from supported links without complicated steps.
InSaver provides a fast and easy workflow:

Copy link → open InSaver → automatic detection → start download.
Or share link to InSaver → automatic parsing → download starts.

Key functions
✓ Video saver: save short videos and video posts to your device
✓ Photo saver: save photos from supported posts
✓ Story saver: save story videos and story photos when available
✓ Music saver: save music or audio when available in the content
✓ Auto detection: detect supported copied or shared links in most cases
✓ Batch save: save multiple photos or videos when a post contains multiple items
✓ Offline player: watch saved videos offline anytime
✓ Copy captions & hashtags: copy description text and hashtags when available
✓ Simple & safe: clean UI, easy steps, lightweight experience

How to save media
Copy Link
① Copy a supported link for a video, post, story, photo, or music.
② Open InSaver.
③ InSaver will detect the link and start parsing it in most cases.

Share to InSaver
① Tap “Share” on the content link.
② Choose “InSaver” from the Share menu.
③ InSaver will parse the link and save the available video or photo.

Use cases
Save videos from supported links
Save photos from supported posts
Save stories when available
Save music or audio when available
Save videos for offline viewing
Batch save photos and videos
Copy captions and hashtags
Manage saved media easily

Important notes
• InSaver only works with links provided by the user.
• Some content may be restricted and may require login to access. InSaver only helps save content you have permission to view.
• Download availability depends on the source link, network conditions, and content permissions.
• Please respect copyright. Always obtain permission from the content owner before reposting or using saved files.

Disclaimer
InSaver is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to any social media platform or its parent company.
All trademarks, brand names, and logos belong to their respective owners.
